mint_(nikke).description:
A playable character in [[Goddess of Victory: Nikke|]]. She is a former member of the pop [[idol]] group [[T.T. Star (nikke)|]] along with [[Anis (Nikke)|]] and [[Prika (nikke)|]]. Mint and Prika would later reform T.T. Star as an idol duo.

As a human, Mint was present at [[Pretty (nikke)|]]'s comeback concert where the latter was assassinated. Mint was one of five casualties caused by the ensuing riot, alongside [[Anis (nikke)|]]. She and Anis were turned into Nikkes under Tetra Line and Mint would later form [[T.T. Star (nikke)|]] with Anis and [[Prika (nikke)|]], which was managed by [[Hanson (nikke)|]]. Eventually, the group would have a falling out and disbanded, with Mint later becoming a professional [[chef]].

Mint has [[long hair|long]] [[straight hair|straight]] [[black hair]] with [[hair intakes]], [[green eyes]], [[medium breasts]], [[multicolored nails|multicolored]] [[silver nails|silver]], [[pink nails|pink]] and [[aqua nails]], and a [[mole]] under her [[mole under eye|right eye]], by her [[mole on collarbone|collarbone]] and on her [[mole on breast|left breast]]. She wears a [[white shirt|white]] [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[turtleneck]] [[crop top]] with a [[cat cutout|cat-shaped]] [[cleavage cutout]], a [[frilled skirt|frilled]] [[layered skirt|layered]] [[plaid skirt|plaid]] [[blue skirt|blue]], [[black skirt|black]] and [[white skirt|white]] [[high-waist skirt]], a [[white pantyhose|white]] [[fishnet pantyhose]] with [[star (symbol)|star]]-shaped decorations, [[white socks]] and a pair of [[grey shoes|silver]] [[platform shoes]]. She has a [[blue hairband]] and a [[fish hair ornament]] in her hair, an [[earpiece]] and [[microphone]] in her right ear, three multicolored [[bead bracelet]]s on her right arm, a white, fluffy cat-themed [[wrist cuffs|wrist cuff]] on her left arm and [[multiple rings]]. She also has a [[cat ornament]] with [[white ribbon]]s by her neck, a glittery silver [[arm strap]] on her right arm and [[plaid bow|plaid]] [[blue bow]]s on her skirt.

She wields a [[rocket launcher]] called Coyly Star.

Like the other T.T. Star members, Mint is named after the herb [[mint|Mentha]].

Voice actresses: [[Takao Kanon]] (JP) and [[Rebecca Wang]] (EN)

arcana_(nikke).description:
A playable character from [[Goddess of Victory: Nikke]]. A member of the [[Best Seller (nikke)|]] squad, along with [[Phantom (nikke)|]] and [[Label (Nikke)|]]. 
 
She is an extrovert through and through, with a friendly personality that makes her able to get along with just about anyone.

She also runs a small [[tarot]] shop as a side business. Her proclivity for eccentricity is channeled into her unique interpretations of tarot cards, which she then uses to tease others (mostly the [[Commander (nikke)|]]). Her readings tend to be surprisingly accurate, so her shop was quite successful.

Illustrator: [[tigerMtang]] 
Voice actress: [[Skyler Davenport]] (EN), [[Murakami Natsumi (voice actor)|]] (JP)

prika_(nikke).description:
An upcoming playable character in [[Goddess of Victory: Nikke|]]. She is a former member of the pop [[idol]] group [[T.T. Star (nikke)|]] alongside [[Anis (Nikke)|]] and [[Mint (nikke)|]]. 

In contrast to her fellow [[T.T. Star (nikke)|]] members, Prika was originally supposed to debut as a human, though she would end up dying in a [[car crash|traffic collision]]. She was later turned into a Nikke under Tetra Line and formed T.T. Star with [[Anis (nikke)|]] and [[Mint (nikke)|]], which was managed by [[Hanson (nikke)|]]. Eventually, the group would have a falling out and disbanded, with Prika later making a living selling accessories.

Prika has [[short hair|short]] [[blonde hair]] with [[brown hair|brown]] [[roots (hair)|]] and bangs hanging [[hair between eyes|between her eyes]], [[blue eyes]], [[medium breasts]], [[long fingernails|long]] [[grey nails]] and a [[mole]] on her [[mole on stomach|stomach]]. She normally wears a [[crop top|cropped]] [[white hoodie|white]] [[cropped hoodie|hoodie]] with [[drawstring]]s, [[long sleeves]] [[sleeves past wrists|past her wrists]] and [[shoulder cutout]]s, a cropped [[black shirt|black]] [[cropped shirt|shirt]], [[blue pants]] and a pair of [[grey shoes|grey]] [[sneakers]]. She has a [[white hairband]] in her hair and a bandaid on the side of her [[bandaid on stomach|stomach]].

Her name is a play on the spice paprika.

Voice actresses: [[Shimabukuro Miyuri]] (JP) and [[Elizabeth Maxwell]] (EN)

An overarching antagonist of [[Wuthering Waves]].

Represented as a black hole, Aleph-1 is a Threnodian not native to Solaris-3, the game's primary setting. It is trapped behind the Stridergate located in the Roya Frostlands, making it the region's Threnodian. Its influence manifests as corruption of constructs created from [[Exostrider (Wuthering Waves)|]] debris called [[exoswarm (wuthering waves)|]] and as Void Storms where the complete break down of information and existence occurs.
